decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Flood Risk Assessment 86252-Debonair-WiltonAve dated January 2016 by UNDA

112PR008 Rev A, 112PR007 Rev A, 112PR002 Rev A, 112PR006 Rev A, 112PR005a Rev A, 112PR010 Rev A - Received 28/4/16
  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional giving details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. It is necessary for this information to be provided prior to commencement as to do so at a later stage could have a material impact on the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Flood Risk Assessment reference 86252-Debonair-WiltonAve dated January 2016 by UNDA

Condition : 7 - The basement shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house known as number "2 Wilton Avenue, Chiswick, W4 2HY" and for no other purpose.  A purpose incidental to a dwelling house would not cover commercial uses or separate self-contained accommodation
description: Proposed extension to existing cellar to create a basement with front and rear lightwells
